stem.text: Propan-1-ol, $\text{C}_3\text{H}_7\text{OH}$, is dehydrated by passing its vapour over hot aluminium oxide to give a hydrocarbon.
Which structural formula represents the product obtained when the hydrocarbon reacts with bromine?

A.alt: Structural formula CH3CH2CH2Br, drawn with vertical bonds

B.alt: Structural formula CH3CHBrCH3, drawn with vertical bonds

C.alt: Structural formula CH3CH2CHBr2, drawn with vertical bonds

D.alt: Structural formula CH3CHBrCH2Br, drawn with vertical bonds
